long_biography.plain_text:
Investor Denby Roberts helped establish a scholarship at St Hilda's for a girl whose family could not otherwise afford the school. It covered six years of tuition from Year 7 and combined financial need with general excellence. A scholarship bearing her family's name also offered full secondary-school tuition at Christ Church Grammar School.

Her support for young musicians includes patronage of the Australian Chamber Orchestra's Peter Shorthouse scholarship fund. The fund seeks to support an emerging string player within a year-long programme of rehearsals, mentoring and performances with the orchestra. Programme costs include wages, travel and touring, allowing participants to gain professional experience alongside established players.
